arguments.content: The ChatGPT relay loop produced an operational method observation Anthony explicitly accepted: IRIS Gate cross-architecture critique is doing more than independent technical error checking; it also acts as continuity verification across the corpus. ChatGPT repeatedly carried forward constraints from prior uploaded work that the Claude-side reasoning had not surfaced from inside the active conversation, especially the SAD immune-quarantine constraint around CBD and T-cell suppression in immunotherapy contexts. Anthony registered that cross-architecture critique caught not only current-step mathematical/methodological errors but also failures to carry forward archived constraints. Future instances should apply this: when a new hypothesis seems plausible, check it against prior kill conditions and quarantines, not just against fresh citations.
